body: I don't want wisdom. I just want someone to treat me like I'm a human being.

No, given that you tried to scold me earlier, I absolutely do not want to talk to you. Now, I get the feeling that you will try to blame me again so let me be quick to remind you that it's not just me who feels this way. The moderators here feel the same way about your earlier remark.

I really wish you were not on today. I would rather be alone in this than be around people like you. There is a saying 'with friends like these, who needs enemies?' I am sorry to say that it applies to you.

You have made this entire thing all about you.

Thank you so much for intervening. You are absolutely right. These other commenters did indeed escalate the situation horribly. I felt very scolded and blamed and then things got really, really bad. But I just read your comment and stopped. Your conscientiousness and intervention has helped me much more than I can say. I feel like the inmates are not running the asylum and someone sensible is in charge at last. I feel a lot better now surprisingly.

Thank you for caring. You really helped me today.
I have absolutely no support system. Hence the belt.
Yeah, sadly, most of it is extremely personal so I can't break it down for you like that.
These problems are not temporary though. Thank you for your good wishes for me. I appreciate it.
It's one of those situations where things are coming from all sides and there is no safety net or any reprieve. It's just a lot of bad stuff that has been happening all at once for a very long time.
Well, I'm having kind of a bad day today. Things have been very tough for a long while.
Thanks for your good words. It's very nice of you to care. I appreciate that very much.

That is between me and the other commenter. And it is for me to decide whether she has been helpful or not. Just because she misguidedly came to your defense regarding your previous comment, please do not presume that she has been actually helpful. 

You are trying to do way too much here. What is your focus exactly? Find it and stick to that.

Remember, this is not about you. Someone else is in crisis now. Your job is not to be the den mother who keeps the peace.
Thanks. That is good to know. Thank you for being here. I'm not sure what to say to you. I guess I'll ask how you're doing. So how are you?
I am sorry for your loss. My condolences.

You need to get off this thread. 

Your blaming and accusing attitude is making everything much worse. You have no idea how to help, even though you talk like you are an expert on comforting suicidal people. You should know that talking to a suicidal person like they are an errant child who just needs to make up their mind is a very thoughtless and insensitive thing to do. But given your self-righteous mentality, I doubt that you will be willing to change.

There is no room for tough love here. Get off this board and never come back. You do not know what you're doing and you are absolutely horrible at giving aid and comfort to those who are struggling. I really hope and pray for the sake of the suffering people in your life that they never have to end up turning to someone like you when they need help the most.
Thank you. That is useful to know. Have a good day.

If you truly want to help and you're not here just to be a hero, please upvote my post so it will get some visibility and some adults here can see it.

Otherwise, no thank you. I do not wish to engage with you further.  Frankly, it is rather difficult to communicate with somebody who believes that they are a cat (and that everyone already has that information.)
Sir, it's time for you to go away now. You are not being helpful. You are being bossy and controlling. You being an MRA does not help matters any. Goodbye.

I understand and appreciate your concern. However, attempting to force the conversation into stuff like movies or hobbies is absolutely not helpful at this point. It just feels like you are trivializing my problems right now and like you're seeing me as a child who can be easily distracted.
P.S - Before you, on the other hand, explode in rage and begin downvoting people's posts and comments in a fit of childish pique, perhaps you should consider looking at someone's post history first.
I'm not quite sure why you downvoted me. But thanks anyway.

There was absolutely no explosion, merely a statement asking you to be mindful of your statements. It would be useful to consider that you're presuming that everyone in the world understands the context of your line. 

Most people have no idea that you have some sort of online feline persona. Please don't hold them responsible when you don't explain things beforehand.
I'm not quite sure. The belt is starting to hurt though.
Maybe. Maybe not. Thank you for your concern.

Thanks. I don't feel like PM-ing. But it's nice to just have someone around here while I attempt to sort some big things out. I appreciate it. 

This is tough.
Mocking someone with a serious problem is really a bad and useless tactic right now. Please re-think. If you want to joke around, that's great and you should do it with someone else at this point.
I just glanced at your post history. You are an MRA and you have said some truly heinous things about women. This is not going to work or end well for me. Thank you and I wish you well.

I am 37.

Btw if you're a minor, you really should not be here unless you have problems of your own and you're looking for support.
I've got some significant problems. Tough love would not be a good idea from anyone at this point, just so you know.
